_comment: GL-25b (CR-371, 2026-10-07): the downgrade floor every signer stamps into a companion/onboard record when no --min-version / CCSYNC_MIN_VERSION is given. Raise it at launch and at every release that fixes something a downgrade would reintroduce. Owner: pick the real launch values here before the beta opens.
